cards.name: Frodo Baggins
cards.text: Response: Spend 1 [fellowship] resource and exhaust The One Ring to cancel the effect of an encounter card just revealed from the encounter deck. Shuffle that card back into the encounter deck and reveal another encounter card.
cards.flavor: "I will take the Ring," he said, "though I do not know the way." <cite>The Fellowship of the Ring</cite>

cards.name: Shady Bree-Lander
cards.text: While the One Ring is exhausted, Shady Bree-lander gains: "Cannot be optionally engaged."
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending character gets -1 [defense] (-2 [defense] instead if The One Ring is exhausted).

cards.name: The Ringwraiths Attack
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Weathertop and The Witch-king to the staging area.  Search the encounter deck and discard pile and add each Nazgûl enemy found to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: If there are no Nazgûl enemies in play, the players win the game.

cards.name: Into the Wild
cards.back_text: When Revealed: Add Midgewater to the staging area.  Each player places 1 progress on the current quest.  Forced: At the end of the round, either remove X progress from the current quest or shuffle 1 out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck.  X is the number of players in the game.  The players cannot advance while Midgewater is in play.

cards.name: Ringwraith
cards.text:
Cannot have non-Morgul attachments.
Forced: When Ringwraith attacks, deal it an additional shadow card if The One Ring is exhausted.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Pathless Country
cards.text: Pathless Country gets +4 quest points while in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: After this attack, the attacking enemy engages the next player then makes an immediate attack.

cards.name: Rider of Mordor
cards.text:
Cannot have non-Morgul attachments.
While Rider of Mordor is engaged with a player, characters that player controls get -1 [willpower].  While The One Ring is exhausted, Rider of Mordor gets -10 engagement cost.

cards.name: Power In Their Terror
cards.text: When Revealed: Each ally gets -1 [willpower] until the end of the round. Deal 2 damage to each ally with 0 [willpower].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a non-objective attachment you control.

cards.name: Lure of the Ring
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: The first player must either exhaust The One Ring or raise his threat by 3.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if The One Ring is exhausted).

cards.name: Pale Blade
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Attach to a Nazgûl enemy in play, if able. (Counts as a Weapon attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per enemy.  Attached enemy gets +1 [attack] and cannot take non-combat damage.")

cards.name: Bill Ferny
cards.text:
Players cannot optionally engage Bill Ferny.
Forced: At the beginning of the staging step, either shuffle 1 out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck or each player raises his threat by 1 for each non-[fellowship] hero he committed to the quest.

cards.name: Squint-Eyed Southerner
cards.text: When Revealed: You must either shuffle an out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck or reveal an additional encounter card.

cards.name: Piercing Cry
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Nazgûl enemy. Either add it to the staging area or put it into play engaged with the first player.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Midgewater
cards.text: While Midgewater is the active location, enemies cannot attack, take damage, or be engaged.  Forced: After Midgewater becomes the active location, return each engaged enemy in play to the staging area.

cards.name: The Prancing Pony
cards.text: Response: After the players travel here, the first player puts 1 ally into play from his hand.  Forced: After the Prancing Pony leaves play, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until X enemies have been discarded.  X is the number of players in the game. Put each enemy discarded by this effect into play engaged with the first player.

cards.name: Weathertop
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
While Weathertop is in the victory display, each enemy in play gets -1 [threat].  Travel: The first player must exhaust The One Ring to travel here.

cards.name: The Witch-king
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects.
The Witch-king gets -30 engagement cost while The One Ring is exhausted.  Characters with 1 [willpower] or less cannot defend attacks made by The Witch-king.

cards.name: The One Ring
cards.text: Setup: The first player claims The One Ring and attaches it to the Ring-bearer.  Attached hero does not count against the hero limit. The first player gains control of the attached hero.  If The One Ring leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Trouble in Bree
cards.text: Setup: Set all copies of Ringwraith, The Witch-king, Midgewater, and Weathertop aside, out of play.  Add The Prancing Pony and Bill Ferny to the staging area.  Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: The players cannot advance while The Prancing Pony is in play.

cards.name: Unwanted Attention
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: You must either remove 2 heroes you control from the quest or shuffle an out of play Ringwraith into the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Weather Hills
cards.text: Response: After the players travel here, place 1 non-unique enemy in play facedown under this location.  While an enemy is under this location, it is out of play.  Forced: After this location leaves play, return each enemy under it to the staging area face-up.

cards.name: Chetwood
cards.text: While Chetwood is in the staging area, Spy enemies get +1 [threat] and +1 [attack].
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player discards 1 random card from his hand.

cards.name: Black Breath
cards.text:
Peril.
When Revealed: Attach to a hero you control.  (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Limit 1 per hero. Reduce attached hero's [willpower], [attack], and [defense] to 0.")
